allowed_development_inputs: new synthetic fixtures with predeclared expected structural truth
mutation-algebra fixtures derived from carrier-neutral transformations
exact bytes from explicitly classified POST_RESULT_DEVELOPMENT_ONLY cases for integration/debugging
historical frozen artifacts for diagnosis and paired replay
authoritative public semantics used only as development evidence, never as hidden future-gold input

development_behavioral_anchors.purpose: Development-only objectives; success here is not fresh generalization evidence.
development_behavioral_anchors.unit004: E2 should be capable of emitting a positive regression witness or an explicitly diagnosed remaining obligation; a repository-specific special case is prohibited.
development_behavioral_anchors.unit006: E2 should be capable of establishing the carried resourceVersion/guard path or explicitly localizing the remaining structural obligation.
development_behavioral_anchors.unit007: E2 must not invent the missing authoritative external consequence/refinement; continued abstention is admissible and may be the correct endpoint.
development_behavioral_anchors.unit008: E2 should be capable of identifying retrieved-but-discarded last_commit_id and the resulting effect-boundary guard loss or explicitly localizing the remaining structural obligation.

corpus01-unit-003.known_signal: acquisition precision and structural extraction ceiling

corpus01-unit-004.known_signal: conditional effect collapsed to unconditional delete; zero-evidence fail-closed acquisition failure

corpus01-unit-006.known_signal: resourceVersion survives object modeling and serialization into effectful PATCH

corpus01-unit-007.known_signal: target forwards version but authoritative external stale/non-next consequence and refinement remain unresolved

corpus01-unit-008.known_signal: current identity can be retrieved but is discarded before existing-file PUT; stale and match worlds collapse

development_exit_gates: deterministic outputs under repeated identical inputs
zero preservation-from-name-only or decorative-flow evidence in adversarial qualification
negative-control transformations that preserve consequence semantics do not become regression solely because of renaming, wrapper depth, or serialization spelling
positive mutation families that remove, overwrite, discard, bypass, or misbind a consequence-defining coordinate are detectable when the required evidence is within the declared E2 scope
all exact repositories/bytes used in development are frozen into a development-universe manifest before the fresh evaluation block
exact E2 engine and qualification bytes are frozen before any fresh held-out target is selected or semantically inspected

development_target_byte_rule.condition: Their use must be recorded in the E2 development-universe manifest before the E2 implementation freeze.
development_target_byte_rule.consequence: Any repository whose target bytes are used for E2 development or qualification becomes ineligible for the primary fresh held-out block.

required: TypeScript/JavaScript support in addition to retained Python/Go support
content-derived dependency expansion without unbounded crawl

A2_normalized_flow.goal: Represent consequential coordinate survival across aliases, object properties, keyword/field mappings, helper calls, wrappers, and serialization renames.

required_capabilities: current-state read to returned identity propagation
serialization rename tracking such as snake_case to wire-field spelling

A4_guard_effect_linkage.goal: Distinguish a decorative comparison from a guard that actually conditions the declared effect or stale-mismatch outcome.
A4_guard_effect_linkage.minimum_evidence: explicit evidence-backed control/data-flow relation; name similarity alone is insufficient

every_edge_requires: source span or deterministic structural reference
A5_explanation_certificate.required_path_shape: semantic coordinate -> representation/flow -> guard or loss point -> effect -> consequence obligation

A7_independent_checking.preservation: mandatory independent finite/refinement certificate check within the declared scope
A7_independent_checking.regression: mandatory independent recomputation of the concrete distinction-collapse witness
A7_independent_checking.symbolic_proof_lane: optional shadow lane until separately qualified; producer proof search remains outside the trusted base

effective_scope: E2 development only; does not alter any E0/E1 or CTV scientific record
normative_invariants: CTV v0.1 plus its already-frozen amendment remains the semantic authority for canonical gold verdicts; E2 does not rewrite those semantics.
All E0/E1 first predictions, gold models, closure records, and checker outputs are immutable historical scientific objects.
E2 machine outputs remain predictions/evidence and never become canonical scientific consequence authority by themselves.
Absence of evidence may cause abstention but may never by itself produce a regression or preservation upgrade.
Every definitive E2 prediction must be independently checkable from a bounded evidence-bearing certificate or witness.
Repository-specific names, paths, symbols, organizations, or API identifiers from development targets may not become special-case engine logic.
Any post-freeze normative change to this charter requires a new numbered version or amendment stating timing relative to all observed E2 development and evaluation results.

post_development_rule.fresh_evaluation: Only a new precommitted block governed by the frozen E2 evaluation contract may support fresh E2 generalization claims.
post_development_rule.repair_synthesis: May be developed after or alongside E2, but repairs to fresh held-out targets may occur only after that target's first machine result and gold classification are irreversibly closed.
post_development_rule.second_profile: Forbidden as a primary E2 objective; may be proposed only after the fresh E2 block is closed and repeated evidence supports another carrier-neutral primitive.

non_objectives: claim population accuracy from development cases
make the machine producer canonical consequence authority
open a second consequence profile before the E2 fresh held-out block is closed
optimize for a desired number of regressions or stable cases
scientific_objective.primary: Increase machine-first selective coverage and positive consequence-regression detection while preserving fail-closed behavior and the frozen CTV verdict semantics.
